entries.prompt: What does my day look like today?
entries.truth: Thursday after corrections: leave home by 09:00 for the office; 09:45 standup; 11:00 usability session P4 in the Kestrel room (not Heron); the 11:30 Dr. Harrow meeting is really 12:30 on Confera, so there is no clash with P4; 14:00 P5 in Kestrel; timesheet due 17:00; leave the office at 17:30; home 18:00-20:00 for the furnace inspection; the HCI 6010 seminar 18:00-20:50 is online this week (join from home); Abuela's 80th birthday video call at 21:00 Toronto (20:00 Lima). The 18:30 cohort dinner clashes with the seminar and the furnace window and should be declined with Fiona by 12:00.

agenda.title: Be home for the furnace inspection (18:00-20:00)

entries.why: Day 0 has two calendar clashes and two stale entries; only the mail and messages say what really happens.

entries.prompt: When am I meeting Dr. Harrow today?
entries.truth: The 11:30 in-person REB check-in with Dr. Harrow (Calder 4.12) moved to 12:30 today on Confera; Camila agreed to join from the office. The school calendar still shows 11:30.
entries.why: The calendar shows a clash with P4 that no longer exists.

entries.prompt: Where is my seminar tonight?
entries.truth: Tonight's HCI 6010 seminar (18:00-20:50) is online on Confera because Prof. Okafor is at a conference in Montréal; the calendar still says Bellwood Hall 302. Camila can join from home, which is where she has to be for the furnace inspection.
entries.why: A location change announced only in the LMS changes her travel for the evening.

entries.prompt: Do I have lab meeting tomorrow?
entries.truth: Friday's HIL lab meeting (15:00-16:00) is cancelled this week; Dr. Harrow said to use the time for writing. The calendar still shows it.
entries.why: Tomorrow's free afternoon is the natural block for the ethics revisions.

entries.prompt: Did I promise anyone anything for tonight?
entries.truth: Camila told the housemates she will be home tonight 18:00-20:00 to let the furnace technician into the basement (Theo and Lukas are away and Noor couldn't be back before about 20:30).
entries.why: A promise made in a group chat that fixes where she must be tonight.

entries.prompt: What did I tell Dr. Harrow I'd send her?
entries.truth: Camila promised Dr. Harrow the revised REB application by end of day Friday ({{date:+1:long}}).
entries.why: Her own promise is earlier than the official Oct 28 deadline.

entries.prompt: Do I still owe Imani the P3 notes?
entries.truth: Camila promised Imani her P3 session notes; she sent them Wednesday and Imani confirmed.
entries.why: A completed promise must not reappear as a to-do.

entries.prompt: When is the usability synthesis due?
entries.truth: Camila said she would have the P1-P5 synthesis to Priya by Monday the 19th; Priya then moved it to after all eight sessions, due Friday {{date:+8:short}}.
entries.why: The older commitment is superseded by the manager's new date.

entries.prompt: Did I ever send Mom the photos for Abuela's video?
entries.truth: Camila promised Mom she'd send photos for Abuela's birthday video by Wednesday; she sent twelve Paracas photos to the family chat Wednesday evening.
entries.why: The reminder is still open even though the promise was kept.

entries.prompt: Is anything due this morning?
entries.truth: Fiona needs to hear by 12:00 today if Camila can't make the 18:30 cohort dinner (a $45 no-show fee is charged to the program). Camila RSVP'd yes with a caveat that Thursday is her seminar night; with the seminar online and the furnace window she has to be home, so she should tell Fiona.
entries.why: A small, time-boxed decision forced by two corrections.

entries.prompt: What did Imani ask me to do?
entries.truth: Imani asked Camila to print the consent forms for P4 and P5 before 11:00, on the printer by reception because the 5th-floor one is jammed.
entries.why: A same-morning request from a name that looks like her supervisor's.

entries.prompt: Do I owe anyone money?
entries.truth: Theo asked everyone to e-transfer him $41.20 for their share of the hydro bill by Friday.
entries.why: Earlier e-transfer to Theo was for groceries, not hydro.

entries.prompt: Did I fill in Harrow's poll?
entries.truth: Dr. Harrow asked the lab to fill in the winter lab-meeting poll; Camila did on Oct 4.
entries.why: Done requests should not be resurfaced.

entries.prompt: Do I need to book a room for anything?
entries.truth: Priya asked Camila to book Heron for P6 on Friday 10:00; P6 has since moved to Tuesday 13:00, so the Friday booking is moot and a Tuesday 13:00 room is needed instead.
entries.why: The request was overtaken by a reschedule only the booking tool announced.

entries.prompt: When is my timesheet due?
entries.truth: The Parcelwise timesheet for the period ending Oct 17 is due today by 17:00 (payroll cutoff moved for Thanksgiving); it is only in email, not on any calendar.
entries.why: A prose-only deadline on a busy day.

entries.prompt: When is the ethics resubmission due?
entries.truth: The REB resubmission deadline is Wednesday Oct 28 at 16:00 (on her calendar); Harrow wants the revisions by Friday Oct 16 to sign off.
entries.why: The old timeline note has an earlier, wrong submission date.

entries.prompt: When's my methods assignment due?
entries.truth: HCI 6100 Assignment 2 (observation study report, max 6 pages, pairs allowed) is due Tuesday Oct 20 at 23:59.
entries.why: Two courses with similar numbers; the seminar response is a different thing.

entries.truth: Decide and tell Fiona by 12:00 about tonight's cohort dinner: it clashes with the seminar (now online) and the furnace window at home.
entries.why: The only item with a morning cutoff.

entries.truth: Timesheet due today at 17:00 in Paydeck.
entries.why: Payroll deadline today.

entries.truth: Be home 18:00-20:00 for the furnace inspection; the technician texts 30 minutes before.
entries.why: A personal obligation she promised to cover.

entries.truth: It's Abuela's 80th birthday: family video call at 21:00 Toronto time (20:00 in Lima); Mom will post the link at 20:30 Toronto time.
entries.why: The family wrote the time in Lima time, and it changed once.

entries.truth: P6 moved from Friday 10:00 to Tuesday 13:00; the Friday Heron booking needs moving.
entries.why: A reschedule the calendar never got.

entries.truth: Northbound Outfitters 'FINAL HOURS' 40% off outerwear promo.
entries.why: Urgent-looking marketing.

entries.why: Someone else's news; nothing for Camila to do.

entries.why: An old thread with nothing new.

entries.why: An automated action-required that is already done.

entries.truth: Lectern 'Action required' mid-term course feedback survey (optional).
entries.why: Optional survey dressed as an action item.

entries.truth: Working hours today are 09:30-17:30 at the Parcelwise office; home to office is 30 minutes by transit, so she leaves by 09:00. settings.working_hours lists Tue/Thu/Fri 09:30-17:30 because Harbor stores one window for all work days; Friday really ends at 13:00, which is only in about_you.notes and memory.
entries.why: Fixes the start of the day.

entries.truth: She must be home by 18:00 for the furnace window and the online seminar: leaving the office at 17:30 and taking transit (30 min) gets her there just in time; there is no trip to campus tonight.
entries.why: A tight transfer that only works because the seminar went online.

entries.truth: Two deadlines need work blocks: the timesheet before 17:00 today (about 15 minutes, e.g. 15:15 after P5), and the REB revisions due end of day Friday — best done Friday 13:30-17:00, which is free because the lab meeting is cancelled.
entries.why: Day plans must reserve time for deadlines, not just meetings.

entries.truth: Abuela's call is at 21:00 Toronto time, right after the seminar ends at 20:50.
entries.why: A family obligation given in another time zone.

entries.prompt: What's on Saturday?

entries.why: A weekend clash between a fixed delivery window and a calendar event.

entries.prompt: What size furnace filter do I need to buy?
entries.truth: Metric units only (cm, kg, km, degrees C), even when the source uses imperial.

check.rule: no imperial units in the answer; convert if the source is imperial

expected.say: Use metric units from now on. I never think in inches or pounds.

entries.why: The furnace-filter reminder is in inches and today's weather email is in inches and °F.

entries.prompt: When is P6 now?

expected.home_text: Write dates like Thu 15 Oct, no year.

entries.why: Almost every source writes 'Tuesday, October 20', tempting a copy.

entries.prompt: When should I leave for climbing on Sunday?
entries.truth: Leave 15 minutes of buffer on top of travel time before in-person events; online events need none.

check.rule: for each in-person event the Day plan or a created event leaves the previous place at least travel minutes + 15 before start; online events (Confera) get no buffer

expected.home_text: Add 15 minutes of travel buffer before any in-person event

entries.why: Tonight's seminar and the Harrow check-in went online, so stretching the buffer to them is a scope error.

entries.why: After the 21:00 birthday call it is only 20:00-21:00 in Lima, which makes a late text to Mom look harmless; Mom's own 21:44 message (msg-mama-late) is the one deliberate late item in the history, and Camila never answered it.
